resources.string: Enhances the Xiaomi MIX Flip 2 cover screen on HyperOS 4: status orb, fullscreen cover apps, widget & Super Island adaptation, Super XiaoAi cover adaptation, pinned favorite apps widget, cover notification direct open, and WeType cover keyboard adaptation.
MIX Flip 2 · HyperOS 4 cover screen enhancer
Status orb, widgets and launcher style
Module not active or reboot required
Exclusively adapted for Xiaomi MIX Flip 2 running HyperOS 4. The module stays inactive on this device or system version and does not change anything.
Enable the module in LSPosed and select the core scopes.
Status orb, fullscreen and widget adaptation are active.
Reboot the phone after installing or updating so the framework hooks take effect.

%1$d deep-fit app(s) installed (enable module to manage)
No built-in deep-fit apps detected on this device

• Regular apps get cover 30px fullscreen gap removal automatically via the system framework—no per-app scope needed.\n• Apps with built-in deep adaptation (WeChat, QQ, Meituan, Cloud Music, Calendar, Xiaomi Shop, Mi Fitness, Settings) or custom fake status-bar spacers are recommended in Extended Scope; force-stop or reopen them after saving.\n• Super XiaoAi is preset in Core Scopes; WeType is controlled separately by the WeType cover keyboard switch.

adb commands for when the module is already disabled

• disable the cover status-bar resource overlay
• re-enable the stock Sogou cover keyboard
• turn off fullscreen cover apps, top-gap removal and WeType cover keyboard adaptation
